locatorProvenance: Canonical approximate FK5/J2000 RA-hours and Dec-degrees locators supplied in the authorized task, not a replacement astrometric catalog. Associate to nearest actual controlCatalog row within 60 arcsec; equal-distance ties use the brighter component then index, with tied rows retained in report provenance. Alnitak has two identically rounded component coordinates. Use stored row coordinates thereafter. Exported BSC5 rows have no HR identifiers or names: retain row index and full row, never invent an HR number.
sourcePointProvenance: Manually inspected ORIGINAL JPEG crops during this unit. Orion belt, orange Betelgeuse, Rigel, Bellatrix, Saiph and Orion nebula context form a coherent pattern. Distributed bright-object candidates were inspected separately, before rotation fitting. Seeds are approximate native pixel centers, not invented fitted coordinates. Refine only inside a small seed patch; no global nearest-peak search.
